351-of-human-bondage.title: Of Human Bondage
351-of-human-bondage.creator: W. Somerset Maugham
351-of-human-bondage.description: A book by W. Somerset Maugham. The monthly nurse tried to quiet her, and presently, from exhaustion, the crying ceased. The doctor walked to a table on the other side of the room, upon which, under a towel, lay the body of a still-born child. He lifted the towel and looked. He was hidden from the bed by a screen, but the woman guessed what he was doing.

My mother comes to live with me--A Duc de Chartres born  to me--Chateaubriand and M. de Villèle--Epistolary  brevity--Re-establishment of the Censorship--A King of  France should never be ill--Bulletins of the health of  Louis XVIII.--His last moments and death--Ode by Victor  Hugo--M. arxiv-2210-12561.title: Localization properties of harmonic chains with correlated mass and spring disorder: Analytical approach
arxiv-2210-12561.creator: I. F. Herrera-González, J. A. Méndez-Bermúdez
arxiv-2210-12561.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by I. F. Herrera-González, J. A. Méndez-Bermúdez. We study the localization properties of normal modes in harmonic chains with mass and spring weak disorder. Using a perturbative approach, an expression for the localization length L loc L_{\text{loc}} is obtained, which is valid for arbitrary correlations of the disorder (mass disorder correlations, spring disorder correlations, and mass-spring disorder correlations are allowed), and for practically the whole frequency band.

arxiv-2405-08728.title: Dimensionality reduction in bulk–boundary reaction–diffusion systems
arxiv-2405-08728.creator: Tom Burkart, Benedikt J. Müller, Erwin Frey
arxiv-2405-08728.description: Abstract Intracellular protein patterns regulate many vital cellular functions, such as the processing of spatiotemporal information or the control of shape deformations. To do so, pattern-forming systems can be sensitive to the cell geometry by means of coupling the protein dynamics on the cell membrane to dynamics in the cytosol.

arxiv-2405-14101.title: Enhancing Image Layout Control with Loss-Guided Diffusion Models
arxiv-2405-14101.creator: Zakaria Patel, Kirill Serkh
arxiv-2405-14101.description: Abstract Diffusion models are a powerful class of generative models capable of producing high-quality images from pure noise using a simple text prompt. While most methods which introduce additional spatial constraints into the generated images (e.g., bounding boxes) require fine-tuning, a smaller and more recent subset of these methods take advantage of the models’ attention mechanism, and are training-free.

arxiv-2506-12659.title: Finding Some Impossibility of Flat-Folding of Given Origami Crease Pattern by Graphical Representation
arxiv-2506-12659.creator: Chihiro Nakajima
arxiv-2506-12659.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chihiro Nakajima. Flat-foldability problem of origami is the problem to determine whether a given crease pattern drawn on a piece of paper is possible to fold without any penetration or intrusion of a polygon into any connections among them. It is known from the results of Bern and Hayes and following studies that determining whether a origami diagram which constitute of polygons in general shapes can be flat-folded is an NP-hard problem.

arxiv-2509-15200.title: Strong converse exponent of channel interconversion
arxiv-2509-15200.creator: Aadil Oufkir, Yongsheng Yao, Mario Berta
arxiv-2509-15200.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Aadil Oufkir, Yongsheng Yao, Mario Berta. In their seminal work, Bennett et al. Theory (2002)] showed that, with sufficient shared randomness, one noisy channel can simulate another at a rate equal to the ratio of their capacities. We establish that when coding above this channel interconversion capacity, the exact strong converse exponent is characterized by a simple optimization involving the difference of the corresponding Rényi channel capacities with Hölder dual parameters.

arxiv-2509-24684.title: Traumatic Brain Injury Segmentation using an Ensemble of Encoder-decoder Models
arxiv-2509-24684.creator: Ghanshyam Dhamat, Vaanathi Sundaresan
arxiv-2509-24684.description: Abstract The identification and segmentation of moderate-severe traumatic brain injury (TBI) lesions pose a significant challenge in neuroimaging. This difficulty arises from the extreme heterogeneity of these lesions, which vary in size, number, and laterality, thereby complicating downstream image processing tasks such as image registration and brain parcellation, reducing the analytical accuracy.

arxiv-2602-17493.title: Learning with Boolean threshold functions
arxiv-2602-17493.creator: Veit Elser, Manish Krishan Lal
arxiv-2602-17493.description: Abstract We develop a method for training neural networks on Boolean data in which the values at all nodes are strictly ± 1 \pm 1 , and the resulting models are typically equivalent to networks whose nonzero weights are also ± 1 \pm 1 . The method replaces loss minimization with a nonconvex constraint formulation.

britannica-1911-fife-scotland.description: Article 'Fife (Scotland)' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Geology.—Between Damhead and Tayport on the northern side of the low-lying Howe of Fife the higher ground is formed of Lower Old Red Sandstone volcanic rocks, consisting of red and purple porphyrites and andesites and some coarse agglomerates, which, in the neighbourhood of Auchtermuchty, are rounded and conglomeratic. These rocks have a gentle dip towards the S.S.E.

britannica-1911-parker-sir-hyde.title: Parker, Sir Hyde (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-parker-sir-hyde.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-parker-sir-hyde.description: Article 'Parker, Sir Hyde' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 20), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. vice-admiral, was born at Tredington, Worcestershire, on the 25th of February, 1714, his father, a clergyman, being a son of Sir Henry Parker, Bart. His paternal grandfather had married a daughter of Bishop Alexander Hyde, of Salisbury. He began his career at sea in the merchant service. Entering the royal navy at the age of twenty-four, he was made lieutenant in 1744, and in 1748 he was made post-captain.

pmc-10603469.title: Human-centred design bolsters vaccine confidence in the Philippines: results of a randomised controlled trial
pmc-10603469.creator: Mark Donald C Reñosa, Jonas Wachinger, Jerric Rhazel Guevarra, Jhoys Landicho-Guevarra, Mila F Aligato, Vivienne Endoma, Jeniffer Landicho, Thea Andrea Bravo, Carol Malacad, Maria Paz Demonteverde, Catherine Silvestre, Kate Bärnighausen, Till Bärnighausen, Rachel P Chase, Shannon A McMahon
pmc-10603469.description: BackgroundThe public’s confidence in vaccinations has eroded, and anti-vaccination movements have gained traction around the world, including in the Philippines. ‘Salubong’, a Filipino term, refers to welcoming someone back into one’s life and elicits ideas about friendship and family relationships. We extended this concept to vaccines in efforts to design an intervention that would re-welcome vaccines into homes.

pmc-10608640.title: Gas Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry Reveals Stage-Specific Metabolic Signatures of Ankylosing Spondylitis
pmc-10608640.creator: Yixuan Guo, Shuangshuang Wei, Mengdi Yin, Dandan Cao, Yiling Li, Chengping Wen, Jia Zhou, Cora Weigert, Xinyu Liu
pmc-10608640.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) is a type of chronic rheumatic immune disease, and the crucial point of AS treatment is identifying the correct stage of the disease. However, there is a lack of effective diagnostic methods for AS staging. The primary objective of this study was to perform an untargeted metabolomic approach in AS patients in an effort to reveal metabolic differences between patients in remission and acute stages.

pmc-10667687.creator: Qingquan Song, Mujia Ma, Hui Liu, Xiaobin Wei, Xiaoping Chen
pmc-10667687.description: Objective: To quantify the effects of increasing the step length of the split squat on changes in kinematics, kinetics, and muscle activation of the lower extremity. Methods: Twenty male college students participated in the test (age: 23.9 ± 3.7, height: 175.1 ± 4.9).

pmc-10735333.title: COMPARISON OF CLINICAL BIOMARKER AND DNAM-DERIVED BIOLOGICAL AGE MEASURES IN AN ELECTIVE SURGERY COHORT
pmc-10735333.creator: Daniel Parker, Shelley McDonald, Kathryn Porter Starr, Dan Blazer, III, E Shelley Hwang, Allan Kirk, Sandhya Lagoo-Deenadayalan
pmc-10735333.description: Older adults face greater post-operative morbidity due to decreasing biological aging (BA)-associated physical resilience. BA measures may quantify these vulnerabilities. Common BA quantification approaches include measures derived from clinical biomarkers and whole blood DNA methylation. The Duke Surgery One Thousand Patient Cohort is a prospective biospecimen and data repository of patients undergoing elective surgery.

pmc-12615550.title: Continuous Ventricular Irrigation for Intraventricular Hemorrhage
pmc-12615550.creator: Emily G Dunbar, Tanvika Vegiraju, Andrew P Carlson
pmc-12615550.description: Purpose of reviewDespite decades of research, intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) remains a devastating condition with high morbidity and mortality. Traditional external ventricular drains (EVDs) have long served as the cornerstone of surgical management but are limited by various complications. This review evaluates recent literature on continuous ventricular irrigation as an alternative approach to treating IVH.

pmc-12764049.creator: Jiawen Chen, Renjiang Kong, Yuzhi Qiu, Sihan Chen, Yidi Liu, Xi Yu, Xiangliang Yang, Yan Zhang, Yanhong Zhu
pmc-12764049.description: The efficacy of antitumor immunotherapy is closely associated with the expansion of tumor-infiltrating CD8+ T cells. However, within the tumor microenvironment, CD8+ T cells often exhibit reduced proliferation due to persistent exposure to tumor antigens. The cytokine IL-2 is a potent growth factor that can drive the expansion of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes.

uslaw-usc-t26-s546.title: 26 U.S.C. § 546 — Income not placed on annual basis
uslaw-usc-t26-s546.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t26-s546.description: United States Code, Title 26 (Internal Revenue Code); Chapter 1 (Normal Taxes And Surtaxes); Subchapter G (Corporations Used To Avoid Income Tax On Shareholders); Part II (Personal Holding Companies). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Section 443(b) (relating to computation of tax on change of annual accounting period) shall not apply in the computation of the personal holding company tax imposed by section.
